integrity: Proof and separate deterministic exact checker supplied; finite enumeration is corroborative rather than a proof of the general theorem. External independent mathematical auditing has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The result covers finite fields of odd characteristic, any d >= 2, and only unital algebra retractions whose images have vector-space dimension two. No claims concerning other image ranks, characteristic two, algebraic automorphism group schemes, or absolute historical priority are made. Direct enumeration checks prime fields only; infinite families follow from a self-contained proof.
title: Commuting-degree rigidity and orbit spectra for rank-two retracts of odd square-zero monomial complete intersections
